## Description

This PR refactors the project's dependency management by removing `react`, `react-dom`, `react-router-dom`, and their corresponding `@types` from the workspace root `package.json`. These dependencies are now installed directly within the individual applications and packages that explicitly require them.

This change reduces reliance on workspace-level React installations, promoting clearer and more granular dependency management per package.
